نتقارض (form VI)
# نَتَقَارَضُ (nataqāraḍu) /na.ta.qaː.ra.dˤu/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of تَقَارَضَ (taqāraḍa)
# نُتَقَارَضُ (nutaqāraḍu) /nu.ta.qaː.ra.dˤu/: first-person plural non-past passive indicative of تَقَارَضَ (taqāraḍa)
# نَتَقَارَضَ (nataqāraḍa) /na.ta.qaː.ra.dˤa/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of تَقَارَضَ (taqāraḍa)
# نُتَقَارَضَ (nutaqāraḍa)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
